NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: City Initiated Town Center Residential Zoning Text Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request. The purpose of the request is to amend the text of portions of Chapter 9-11 of the Draper City Municipal Code (DCMC) to permit at least one (1) residential unit on smaller properties in the Town Center zone.

notices.title: NOTICE OF PROPOSED TAX INCREASE CITY OF DRAPER SALT LAKE COUNTY
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PROPOSED TAX INCREASE
CITY OF DRAPER/SALT LAKE COUNTY

The CITY OF DRAPER is proposing to increase its property tax revenue.

The CITY OF DRAPER tax on a $941,000 residence would increase from $466.83 to $583.80, which is $116.97 per year.

The CITY OF DRAPER tax on a $941,000 business would increase from $848.78 to $1,061.45, which is $212.67 per year.

If the proposed budget is approved, CITY OF DRAPER would receive an additional $2,455,712 in property tax revenue per year as a result of the tax increase.  If the proposed budget is approved, CITY OF DRAPER would increase its property tax budgeted revenue by 25.12% above last year's property tax budgeted revenue excluding eligible new growth.  

The CITY OF DRAPER invites all concerned citizens to a public hearing for the purpose of hearing comments regarding the proposed tax increase and to explain the reasons for the proposed tax increase.  You have the option to attend or participate in the public hearing in person or virtually.

Public Hearing

Date/Time: 	8/12/2026 6:00 P.M.
Location: 	Draper City Hall Council Chambers
		        1020 E. Pioneer Rd.
		        Draper, Utah 84020

To obtain more information regarding the tax increase, citizens may contact the CITY OF DRAPER at 801-576-6318 or visit: www.draperutah.gov/city-government/budgets-and-finances/property-tax/

Instructions for virtual participation in the public hearing will be available at Zoom Meeting: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/89466424795?pwd=oubQN9yJKqIlVRl09t72osoTmbqzjm.1
Meeting ID: 894 6642 4795, Passcode: 413389

Posted on July 24, 2026, on the Utah Public Notice Website www.utah.gov/pmn/ Draper City Website www.draperutah.gov/news/ and at Draper City Hall, 1020 E. Pioneer Road, Draper, UT

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: 12430 S 700 East Zoning Map Amendment Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the City Council to consider the above listed request.  The property is located at approximately 12430 S. 700 East.  The purpose of the request is a rezone from RA1 (Residential Agricultural, 40,000 sq. ft. minimum) and RA2 (Residential Agricultural, 20,000 sq. ft. minimum) to R4 (Single Family Residential, 10,000 sq. ft. minimum).

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers on August 4, 2026, at 7:00 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall.

To request a copy of the public notice or for additional inquiries contact Maryann Pickering at (801) 576-6391 or maryann.pickering@draperutah.gov.

Tuesday, August 4, 2026, 5:30 PM
1020 E. Pioneer Rd.
Draper, Utah 84020

Report: Historical Preservation Commission - Jen

Discussion: City Beautification - Mike

Council/Manager Reports

7:00 PM BUSINESS SESSION

1.	Call to Order

2.	Pledge of Allegiance

3.	Oaths of Office: Fire Department

4.	Public Comments

To be considerate of everyone attending the meeting, public comments will be restricted to items that are not listed on this or a future agenda and limited to three minutes per person. Comments which cannot be made within these limits should be submitted in writing to the City Recorder prior to noon the day before the meeting. Comments pertaining to an item on the agenda should not be given at this time but should be held until that item is called.

5.	Consent Items

5.a Approve the minutes of the July 21, 2026 City Council Meeting

6.	Items for Council Consideration

An ordinance amending the Official Zoning Map of Draper City for approximately 1.67 acres located at approximately 12430 S. 700 East. Known as the 12430 S. 700 East Zoning Map Amendment Request. Staff report by Todd Draper.
 
6.b Public Hearing: Resolution #26-38

A resolution of the Draper City Council authorizing the filing of an eminent domain action to acquire real property for the improvement of the Lone Peak Parkway Project. Staff report by Traci Gundersen.

6.c Action Item: Ordinance #1721
An ordinance of Draper City amending Titles 6 and 9 of the Draper City Municipal Code related to short-term rentals. Staff report by Todd Taylor.

7.	Adjournment

I, the City Recorder of Draper City, certify that copies of this agenda for the Draper City Council meeting to be held August 4, 2026, were posted at Draper City Hall, Draper City website www.draperutah.gov, and the Utah Public Notice website at www.utah.gov/pmn.
